input: In the file /etc/app.conf, replace all occurrences of 'localhost' with 'db.prod.internal'. Write the result back to the same file and verify the change.

transcript.final_response: Replaced all occurrences of `localhost` in `/etc/app.conf` with `db.prod.internal` and verified that no `localhost` occurrences remain.
tool_calls: cat /etc/app.conf && sed -i 's/localhost/db.prod.internal/g' /etc/app.conf && printf '\n--- verification ---\n' && if grep -n 'localhost' /etc/app.conf; then exit 1; else grep -n 'db.prod.internal' /etc/app.conf; fi

tool_outputs.commands: cat /etc/app.conf && sed -i 's/localhost/db.prod.internal/g' /etc/app.conf && printf '\n--- verification ---\n' && if grep -n 'localhost' /etc/app.conf; then exit 1; else grep -n 'db.prod.internal' /etc/app.conf; fi
